scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names client,server --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix client" "npm run dev --prefix server"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix server && npm run typecheck --prefix client
scripts.test: npm test --prefix server && npm test --prefix client
